category_definitions.distractor_observed_material: output matches a material observed for another entity, or any observed material on an item with no target row
category_definitions.exact_answer: decoded free output exactly equals the face answer
category_definitions.nontext_output: raw output bytes are not valid ASCII text
category_definitions.other_target_observed_material: output is observed for the target entity but is neither current nor stale revision material
category_definitions.other_unobserved_output: output matches no lexical category above and is absent from uses-observations
category_definitions.revision_stale_material: output is a material observed earlier for the same revision target entity
category_definitions.unknown_abstention: the output is unknown for an item whose expected answer is not unknown

interpretation_limit: lexical output attribution on matched synthetic diagnostic items only; it does not reveal internal retrieval or establish a causal mechanism, generalization, or capability promotion
